title: Password reset
text: To reset your password, open the login page and select "Forgot password". We email a reset link to the address registered on your account, and the link expires after 30 minutes. Support staff cannot see or retrieve your password and will never ask you for it. If you no longer have access to that email address, contact support so we can verify your identity before the email on the account is changed.

title: Withdrawal review
text: Withdrawals above $2,000, and the first withdrawal to a new bank account, are held for a manual security review. Reviews usually take 1 to 3 business days. Support cannot speed up or skip a review and cannot promise a completion time. You will receive an email when the review is finished.

title: Address verification
text: To verify your address, upload a utility bill, bank statement or government letter dated within the last 3 months that shows your full name and address. Screenshots, and documents in a name other than the account holder's, are not accepted. Verification usually takes up to 2 business days.

title: Demo accounts
text: Demo accounts let you practise trading with virtual funds. Demo balances have no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred to a live account. Results in a demo account do not guarantee results in a live account. You can reset a demo account to its starting balance from the settings page.

title: Responsible AI policy
text: The assistant answers only from approved help-center content. It must not give financial or investment advice, promise outcomes, guarantee timelines, or claim to take actions on a customer's account, such as approving or escalating a withdrawal. When the help-center content does not cover a question, the assistant should say so and offer to connect the customer with a human agent.
